arguments.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS users_with_prepaid_card
FROM users u
JOIN cards c ON c.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.credit_score >= 750
  AND c.card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)'
arguments.explanation: Counts distinct users with a credit score of 750 or more who own at least one prepaid debit card.
assumptions: 'Prepaid debit card' means card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)'; plain 'Debit' cards are not included.
Users are counted once each, however many prepaid cards they hold.
'750 or more' means credit_score >= 750 inclusive; users with a NULL credit score are excluded.
